title: This Game Made $1 Billion Faster Than Any Movie 🎮 #shorts
description:
Will GTA 6 beat 3 days to $1 billion? Comment yes or no.

Avengers: Endgame needed 5 days to reach $1 billion. GTA 5 did it in 3. GTA 6 launches on 19 November 2026.

Sources: Guinness World Records (fastest entertainment property to $1 billion; Avengers: Endgame records), Rockstar Games Newswire (release date), Take-Two via mp1st.com (price)
